versions.changelog: Clearer communication on when to use plonky.ai and necessary data shape.

Plonky Forecasting Skill 1.0.0

- Introduces an end-to-end workflow for time-series forecasting using the Plonky API.
- Guides users through authentication, data preparation, uploading, analysis, and interpreting forecast results.
- Describes when statistical forecasting is and isn’t appropriate and suggests alternatives when needed.
- Details best practices for identifying and handling gaps, outliers, duplicates, and segment issues in time-series data.
- Provides clear guidance on workflow steps including optional pre-forecast data analysis.
- Includes specific tool descriptions and usage instructions for all available API endpoints.
